accepted.name: patent_core
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT "id" AS id,
       "type" AS type,
       "number" AS number,
       "country" AS country,
       "date" AS date,
       "abstract" AS abstract,
       "title" AS title,
       "kind" AS kind,
       "num_claims" AS num_claims,
       "filename" AS filename,
       "withdrawn" AS withdrawn
FROM PATENTSVIEW.PATENTSVIEW.PATENT
accepted.description: Normalized projection of the PATENT table exposing canonical identifiers and key attributes (one row per patent). Use this as the central patent relation for joins and downstream aggregations. | Use for: Join patent metadata to inventors/assignees/classifications; Filter patents by date/country/kind; Compute counts of patents per attribute

accepted.name: patent_claims_counts
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  patent_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN source = 'claim' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS claims_count_claim,
  SUM(CASE WHEN source = 'claims_2021' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS claims_count_claims_2021,
  COUNT(DISTINCT source || '::' || COALESCE(uuid, sequence, text)) AS claims_count_distinct_sources
FROM (
  SELECT "patent_id" AS patent_id, "uuid" AS uuid, "sequence" AS sequence, NULL::VARCHAR AS text, 'claim' AS source
  FROM PATENTSVIEW.PATENTSVIEW.CLAIM
  UNION ALL
  SELECT "patent_id" AS patent_id, "uuid" AS uuid, TO_VARCHAR("sequence") AS sequence, "text" AS text, 'claims_2021' AS source
  FROM PATENTSVIEW.PATENTSVIEW.CLAIMS_2021
) t
GROUP BY patent_id
accepted.description: Per-patent aggregated claim counts derived from CLAIM and CLAIMS_2021. Produces counts from both tables separately and a combined count to support analyses when either source may be used. | Use for: Compare claim coverage between sources; Use claim counts to validate or filter patents; Join claim counts to patent metadata for regressions or summaries

accepted.name: patent_inventor_pairs
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT 
  "patent_id" AS patent_id,
  "inventor_id" AS inventor_id,
  "location_id" AS location_id,
  "inventor_id" AS inventor_id_dim,
  "name_first" AS inventor_first_name,
  "name_last" AS inventor_last_name,
  "male_flag" AS inventor_male_flag,
  "attribution_status" AS inventor_attribution_status
FROM PATENTSVIEW.PATENTSVIEW.PATENT_INVENTOR pi
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT 
    "id",
    "name_first",
    "name_last",
    "male_flag",
    "attribution_status"
  FROM PATENTSVIEW.PATENTSVIEW.INVENTOR inv
  WHERE inv."id" = pi."inventor_id"
) inv ON TRUE
accepted.description: One row per (patent_id, inventor_id) association from PATENT_INVENTOR with inventor demographics joined where available. Preserves linkage keys and inventor name/flags for grouping or deduplication. | Use for: Count inventors per patent; Aggregate inventor demographics across patents; Map inventor locations to patents

accepted.name: patent_assignee_pairs
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT "patent_id" AS patent_id,
       "assignee_id" AS assignee_id,
       "location_id" AS location_id
FROM PATENTSVIEW.PATENTSVIEW.PATENT_ASSIGNEE
accepted.description: One row per patent-assignee association from PATENT_ASSIGNEE with assignee and location ids preserved for linking to RAWASSIGNEE or LOCATION tables. | Use for: Aggregate patents by assignee; Join assignees to locations or persistent disambiguation; Compute assignee-level patent portfolios

accepted.name: uspc_current_top_n_rank
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT "uuid" AS uuid,
       "patent_id" AS patent_id,
       "mainclass_id" AS mainclass_id,
       "subclass_id" AS subclass_id,
       "sequence" AS sequence,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "patent_id" ORDER BY "sequence" ASC NULLS LAST) AS classification_rank
FROM PATENTSVIEW.PATENTSVIEW.USPC_CURRENT
accepted.description: Per-patent ranking of USPC_CURRENT classifications by their sequence. Exposes a rank so downstream queries can select the top-N classifications per patent without embedding ORDER/LIMIT in this CTE. | Use for: Select primary USPC classification per patent (WHERE classification_rank = 1); Aggregate patents by top USPC classes; Compare classification assignment ordering across patents

accepted.name: cpc_current_top_n_rank
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT "uuid" AS uuid,
       "patent_id" AS patent_id,
       "section_id" AS section_id,
       "subsection_id" AS subsection_id,
       "group_id" AS group_id,
       "subgroup_id" AS subgroup_id,
       "category" AS category,
       "sequence" AS sequence,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "patent_id" ORDER BY "sequence" ASC NULLS LAST) AS cpc_rank
FROM PATENTSVIEW.PATENTSVIEW.CPC_CURRENT
accepted.description: Per-patent ranking of CPC_CURRENT classifications by sequence to enable selecting top-N CPC groups per patent downstream. | Use for: Select primary CPC classification per patent; Construct patent-by-CPC category matrices; Filter patents by presence of a CPC group in top N

accepted.name: patent_text_lengths
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT p."id" AS patent_id,
       COALESCE(LENGTH(p."abstract"), 0) AS abstract_length_chars,
       COALESCE(dd.length, 0) AS detail_description_length,
       COALESCE(f.num_figures, 0) AS num_figures,
       COALESCE(bst_len.text_length, 0) AS brief_text_length
FROM PATENTSVIEW.PATENTSVIEW.PATENT p
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT "patent_id" AS patent_id,
         "length" AS length
  FROM PATENTSVIEW.PATENTSVIEW.DETAIL_DESC_TEXT_2021
) dd
  ON p."id" = dd.patent_id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT "patent_id" AS patent_id,
         "num_figures" AS num_figures
  FROM PATENTSVIEW.PATENTSVIEW.FIGURES
) f
  ON p."id" = f.patent_id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT "patent_id" AS patent_id,
         SUM(LENGTH("text")) AS text_length
  FROM PATENTSVIEW.PATENTSVIEW.BRF_SUM_TEXT
  GROUP BY "patent_id"
) bst_len
  ON p."id" = bst_len.patent_id
accepted.description: Per-patent measures of text length across available text tables (abstract, detail description length, number of figures, brief text). Useful for filtering patents by document length or merging with other metrics. | Use for: Filter patents by description or abstract length; Study relation between document length and number of claims; Join text length to citation or classification analyses

accepted.name: rawinventor_to_disamb
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT ri."uuid" AS uuid,
       ri."patent_id" AS patent_id,
       ri."inventor_id" AS raw_inventor_id,
       ri."rawlocation_id" AS rawlocation_id,
       ri."name_first" AS name_first,
       ri."name_last" AS name_last,
       ri."sequence" AS sequence,
       pid."disamb_inventor_id_20170808" AS disamb_20170808,
       pid."disamb_inventor_id_20171003" AS disamb_20171003,
       pid."disamb_inventor_id_20171226" AS disamb_20171226,
       pid."disamb_inventor_id_20180528" AS disamb_20180528,
       pid."disamb_inventor_id_20181127" AS disamb_20181127,
       pid."disamb_inventor_id_20190312" AS disamb_20190312,
       pid."disamb_inventor_id_20190820" AS disamb_20190820,
       pid."disamb_inventor_id_20191008" AS disamb_20191008,
       pid."disamb_inventor_id_20191231" AS disamb_20191231,
       pid."disamb_inventor_id_20200331" AS disamb_20200331,
       pid."disamb_inventor_id_20200630" AS disamb_20200630,
       pid."disamb_inventor_id_20200929" AS disamb_20200929,
       pid."disamb_inventor_id_20201229" AS disamb_20201229
FROM PATENTSVIEW.PATENTSVIEW.RAWINVENTOR AS ri
LEFT JOIN PATENTSVIEW.PATENTSVIEW.PERSISTENT_INVENTOR_DISAMBIG AS pid
  ON ri."inventor_id" = pid."rawinventor_id"
accepted.description: Maps RAWINVENTOR occurrences to the most recent available disambiguated inventor id(s) from PERSISTENT_INVENTOR_DISAMBIG. Exposes multiple disambiguation snapshot columns so callers can choose which mapping to use. | Use for: Resolve raw inventor mentions to canonical inventor ids; Track changes in disambiguation over time; Aggregate raw inventor activity by canonical id

accepted.name: persistent_assignee_map
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT "rawassignee_id" AS rawassignee_id,
       "disamb_assignee_id_20181127" AS disamb_20181127,
       "disamb_assignee_id_20190312" AS disamb_20190312,
       "disamb_assignee_id_20190820" AS disamb_20190820,
       "disamb_assignee_id_20191008" AS disamb_20191008,
       "disamb_assignee_id_20191231" AS disamb_20191231,
       "disamb_assignee_id_20200331" AS disamb_20200331,
       "disamb_assignee_id_20200630" AS disamb_20200630,
       "disamb_assignee_id_20200929" AS disamb_20200929
FROM PATENTSVIEW.PATENTSVIEW.PERSISTENT_ASSIGNEE_DISAMBIG
accepted.description: Projection of PERSISTENT_ASSIGNEE_DISAMBIG exposing rawassignee -> multiple disambiguated assignee ids across snapshots. Use to join RAWASSIGNEE.rawassignee_id (or RAWASSIGNEE.assignee_id) to persistent identifiers. | Use for: Map raw assignees to canonical assignee ids; Aggregate patents by persistent assignee identifier; Study changes in assignee disambiguation across snapshots

accepted.name: uspatentcitations_agg_by_patent
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  "patent_id" AS patent_id,
  COUNT(*) AS uspatentcitation_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT "citation_id") AS uspatentcitation_distinct_ids,
  SUM(CASE WHEN "category" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS with_category_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN "country" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS with_country_count
FROM PATENTSVIEW.PATENTSVIEW.USPATENTCITATION
GROUP BY "patent_id"
accepted.description: Per-patent counts of USPATENTCITATION records and breakdowns by category and country to support citation-based metrics. | Use for: Compute forward citation counts; Filter patents by citation activity; Compare citations across categories or source countries

accepted.name: patent_application_summary
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT "patent_id" AS patent_id,
       COUNT(*) AS application_count,
       MIN("date") AS min_application_date,
       MAX("date") AS max_application_date
FROM PATENTSVIEW.PATENTSVIEW.APPLICATION
GROUP BY patent_id
accepted.description: Per-patent aggregation of APPLICATION records: exposes earliest and latest application dates and a count of associated applications to help analyze filing history. | Use for: Analyze application timelines per patent; Filter patents by number of applications; Join application date ranges to patent grant date
